summary: Besqab AB (publ) develops residential properties. The company operates through two segments: Project Development and Investment Properties. The Project Development segment covers the development of housing for residential consumers in ownership and condominium forms, as well as the development of investment properties, including rental apartments, care homes, and other community service properties, and manages the full development chain from analysis, conceptual work, and land acquisition through detailed planning and production. The Investment Properties segment consists of completed rental apartments, nursing homes, and other community service properties. The company delivers housing across various tenure forms and property types, including condominiums, rental properties, ownership rights, single-family houses, and apartment buildings. It executes projects through general contracting and shared contracting models with site management. Besqab AB (publ) serves customers in the Greater Stockholm region and Uppsala, Sweden. Besqab AB (publ) was formerly known as Aros Bostadsutveckling AB (publ) and changed its name to Besqab AB (publ) in April 2024. Besqab AB (publ) was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
